title: Find The Needle Demo
provenance: Reported by derjoshu (highball-db#1496, 2026-11-27), Apple M2, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 51 minutes: with the Steam id given and the steam and vcrun2022 recipes. Frame drops only when a building is selected for the first time. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: The demo of Needless Games' Find The Needle (5160800), a haystack digging game. Reported playable on a base M2 with DXMT on the default engine r28 over 51 minutes, with frame drops the first time a building is selected.

knownIssues.symptom: Frame drops the first time a building is selected (M2, DXMT, Wine 10 r28, highball-db#1496)
